price_data.timestamp_semantics: Printed broker wall-clock fields. Epoch seconds are arithmetic coordinates only; broker UTC offset not established.
price_data.point_size_note: Printed decimal precision is not independently verified SYMBOL_POINT or tick size. SPREAD is in broker points.
price_data.gap_note: Intervals include scheduled broker closures as well as possible missing data. Session metadata is absent; gaps are not assumed tradable.

alignment_method: Map printed signal time plus integer offset to an exact M1 opening timestamp. Compare source alert entry with broker bid open. No interpolation, nearest-day matching, trade simulation, or timezone assertion.

alignment_diagnostics.diagnostic_ranking_note: Ordered by median absolute entry/open deviation in R over available exact minutes. Not a timezone estimate, performance optimization, or proof of matching feeds. Different offsets can compare different subsets.
